back: A text written to be spoken to an audience on an occasion, using direct address and features that help listeners follow it.
Salutation in order of rank → attention-grabbing opening → purpose → signposted points → conclusion/appeal → Thank you for listening.
A question asked for effect, not for an answer, to make listeners think.
Grouping three words or phrases for rhythm and emphasis: clean, safe and welcoming.
Words that guide listeners through a speech: First…, This brings me to…, Finally…

front: Why use inclusive pronouns (we, us, our)?
back: They unite the speaker and audience and make an appeal feel shared.
Writing an essay with a greeting on top: the audience is never addressed again.
Let us all…; I urge each one of you to…; Thank you for listening.
